label: Fig1_TAL_MID
comments: A heparin lock was inserted into a forearm vein to take blood samples, with 5 mL venous blood over sodium EDTA taken at the following time points after dosing: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 and 36 h. Blood samples were centrifuged and the separation of plasma was carried out within 30 min after which the samples were stored at −80°C until analysis.
